name: Prafulla K. Panda

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Prafulla K. Panda, also published as Prafulla Kumar Panda, is an Odisha poet and lecturer. He is the author of Bounty of Silence: Verses Unveiling the Songs of Soul and editor of the anthology Beyond the Horizon. In an interview, he describes writing as a patient process of observing everyday experience and finding words for feeling.

His poems here combine rhyme with direct reflection on responsibility and imagination. ‘Character Is Destiny’ and ‘Work for The Luck’ turn attention from fate toward action. ‘He Too Be Called A Poet’ offers a complementary generosity: the attentive reader, able to preserve beauty and respond to another person’s words, shares in the poet’s work.
